sentences.en: He can't chew well, because he has a toothache now.
sentences.zh: 他嚼东西不好受，因为现在牙疼。

sentences.en: Toothache is one of the worst pains I've been through.
sentences.zh: 牙疼是我经历过的最糟糕的疼痛之一。

sentences.en: Mennad's toothache woke him in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: Mennad被牙疼吵醒，在半夜无法入睡。
